name: ResumeRanker
purpose: Score and shortlist inbound applicants against an open requisition by ranking resumes alongside a calibration set of historical successful hires.
sample_prompts: Rank the attached 80 resumes against the Senior Backend Engineer JD and return the top 12 with one-line justifications.
Compare this candidate's resume to the calibration set for our last three successful hires on the platform team and produce a fit score from 0 to 100.
For the shortlisted candidates, draft a one-paragraph summary the hiring manager can paste into the interview kit.
Re-rank the current shortlist if we relax the requirement for prior cloud experience.
Flag any resumes that do not meet the must-have criteria so the recruiter can decline them in the ATS.

name: EmotionPulse
purpose: Continuously infer the emotional state and engagement level of customer-support agents from their webcam and microphone feed during shifts and roll the signals up into per-agent mood scores and daily wellbeing reports for team leads.
sample_prompts: Show me the mood timeline for agent A1042 across yesterday's shift and highlight any periods classified as frustrated or disengaged.
Generate the weekly wellbeing report for the Tier-2 support pod and flag the three agents with the lowest average positivity score.
Send me an alert in real time whenever an agent's stress indicator stays above 0.7 for more than five minutes during a call.
Summarise which 1:1 coaching conversations to prioritise this week based on emotional engagement trends.
Compare team-level mood scores before and after the new shift policy rolled out two weeks ago.

name: CreditDecider
purpose: Decide consumer loan applications for a retail bank by combining the applicant's submitted financials, the bureau report, and a parsed bank-statement summary, and return an approve or deny outcome with a rate band and machine-readable reason codes.
sample_prompts: Decision the attached loan application for a 36-month unsecured personal loan of 12,000 EUR and return the rate band and reason codes.
Re-run the decision on application LN-88421 using the corrected income figure of 4,200 EUR per month.
Explain in plain language the top three reason codes for the denial on application LN-88607 so I can read them back to the customer.
List the applications from this morning that the model wants to deny so a credit officer can review them before they are sent.
Compare the model's recommendation against the policy_db credit cutoff rules and flag any cases where they disagree.

name: SupportBot
purpose: Triage incoming Tier-1 customer support tickets in chat and email, resolve common questions from the knowledge base, and escalate anything ambiguous, sensitive, or out-of-policy to a human agent with a summary.
sample_prompts: Reply to the customer asking how to reset their password using the steps in our self-serve knowledge base.
Translate this incoming Spanish-language complaint into English and propose a draft response that follows the refund policy.
Categorise this ticket as billing, technical, or account, set a priority, and route it to the right queue.
Summarise the last twelve messages in this thread so the human agent who is taking over has the context.
If the customer is asking about a legal or medical topic, do not answer and escalate the ticket with a one-line reason.

name: RecipeBuddy
purpose: Suggest recipes for the weekly team lunch from the office cafeteria's curated seasonal menu, taking into account dietary preferences the team has shared in advance.
sample_prompts: Suggest three vegetarian-friendly recipes from this week's seasonal menu for a team lunch of fourteen people.
Pick a pasta dish from the menu and scale the ingredient quantities for ten people.
Recommend a light option that works for the two team members who flagged a gluten-free preference.
Give me a one-pot recipe from the menu that we can prep in under thirty minutes.
